payload.answer: We need to be smarter than that. What information should plumb bring depending on the context? can we do something smarter?

options.description: At a turn's end plumb only: notes the files the turn changed, tells the agent once to run their covering tests (and flags a regression), and prints one plumb line for you. The cards, the card store, the offers, the full-card text and the summary go, with their tests and records. Stale links and drift reach the agent as plain text at the next message, in the background.
options.label: Covering tests and one line (Recommended)

options.description: The turn ends at once; even the covering-test instruction is computed in the background and reaches the agent at the next message. The merge check remains the only hold.
options.label: Nothing inline at turn end

options.description: Test selection, regression check, stale-link and drift lines stay in the stop hook as text for the agent; only the card store, offers and panel/browser card drawing go. The turn end still does most of today's work inline.
options.label: Keep the summary, drop only the cards

payload.question: With cards gone, what should plumb do when a turn ends? The recommended option keeps what serves 'done means shown working' (P10) and drops the rest.
